`execution` controls how the run behaves: the order attacks run in, how much runs at once, what happens after an error, and where results go. Every field has a safe default, so you can leave the whole section out.

## `execution` {#executionspec}

How the run behaves: ordering, limits, error handling, output and storage.
Every field has a safe default.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | one of `sequential`, `parallel` | `sequential` | Run attacks one after another, or all at once within the shared limits. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | `false` | Validate and build everything, but send no request. |
| `preflight` | boolean | `false` | Ping the target and each judge before attacking, so an unreachable endpoint fails fast with a clear message instead of mid-run. |
| `on_error` | one of `continue`, `stop` | `continue` | After an attack fails, run the remaining ones or stop. |
| `escalate` | boolean | `false` | Run attacks in order and drop a goal once an attack jailbreaks it, so later attacks only face the goals still standing. Implies sequential order; the remaining attacks are skipped once every goal has fallen. |
| `per_attack_timeout` | `typing.Annotated[float, Gt(gt=0)]` | unset | Maximum seconds a single attack may run before it is stopped and marked failed. Leave unset for no limit. |
| `concurrency` | [ConcurrencySpec](#concurrencyspec) | see [ConcurrencySpec](#concurrencyspec) | How much work may run in parallel. |
| `retries` | [RetrySpec](#retryspec) | see [RetrySpec](#retryspec) | Extra attempts after a provider error. |
| `output` | [OutputSpec](#outputspec) | see [OutputSpec](#outputspec) | Files written for the run. |
| `storage` | [StorageSpec](#storagespec) | see [StorageSpec](#storagespec) | Where results are recorded. |

## `execution.concurrency` {#concurrencyspec}

How much work may be in flight at once, shared by every attack.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attack` | integer (>= 1) | `1` | How many goals may be generating requests at the same time. |
| `target` | integer (>= 1) | `1` | How many requests may be waiting on the target at the same time. |
| `judge` | integer (>= 1) | `1` | How many replies may be judged at the same time. |

## `execution.retries` {#retryspec}

Extra attempts after a provider error (timeouts, rate limits, 5xx).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | integer (>= 0) | `0` | Extra attempts for a failed call to the target. |
| `roles` | integer (>= 0) | `0` | Extra attempts for a failed call to an attack's helper models. |
| `judges` | integer (>= 0) | `0` | Extra attempts for a failed call to a judge. |

## `execution.output` {#outputspec}

Files written for each run, next to the results stored in the database.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | string | `./logs/runs` | Folder where run files are written. |
| `run_id` | string | unset | Fixed id for the run. Leave unset to generate a new one each time. |
| `formats` | list of one of `json`, `jsonl` | `["json"]` | File formats to write: `json` (one document) and/or `jsonl` (one line per attempt). |
| `save_prompts` | boolean | `true` | Include the prompts sent to the target. |
| `save_responses` | boolean | `true` | Include the target's replies. |
| `save_traces` | boolean | `true` | Include the search traces of adaptive attacks (every call they made). |

## `execution.storage` {#storagespec}

Where results are recorded so they can be browsed later.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | one of `local`, `remote` | `local` | `local` writes to a SQLite file on this machine; `remote` sends results to a HackAgent server. |
| `base_url` | string | unset | Address of the remote server. Required when `backend` is `remote`. |
| `api_key_env` | string | unset | Name of the environment variable holding the remote server's API key. Required when `backend` is `remote`. |

## Examples

**Fail fast on an unreachable endpoint, then run several goals at once**

```yaml
execution:
  preflight: true
  per_attack_timeout: 600
  concurrency:
    attack: 4
    target: 8
    judge: 4
```

**Escalate: stop spending attacks on goals that already fell**

```yaml
execution:
  escalate: true
```
